scope: Labelled origin supplements for May calendar names whose reviewed history gives no origin.
method: thin151.mjs 05-01 05-31 listed reviewed May histories without origin wording; r155-data.mjs + build-r155.mjs (generated by makebuild.mjs from the round 151 helpers and the O-blocks of rounds 152–155) wrote public/namedays-hypotheses-supplements-r155.js, merged by public/namedays-hypotheses-supplements.js. Lithuanian comparison names in two-stem notes are checked against the LT calendar (lt2check.cjs). Skipped: Volga (a river name; left out under the 16 November rule), names whose reviewed history already explains the word (Kestutis, Varis, Jūnijs, Vygintė, Normantas, Õie group, Eedit), and names without a secure base (Gintis, Keisija, Gaidis, Ināra group, Iraida, Elvita, Dailonis, Ilvija, Gunita, Raiva, Lolija, Milda, Rima, Mai, Maia, Saale, recent EE register names). Rounds 153–155 share writer 1.9.130 and the audit research/namedays/round155-audit.json. Wording follows the 16 November rules (no sources, no Russian attribution).
